name: Export
description: Exporters that turn a scene into other formats: one frame as an SVG document, a scene as a Lottie JSON document with animated position and easing, and the frame plan (numbers, times, pixel sizes, file names) for a numbered PNG sequence. Output is byte-stable and throws on non-finite values.

relationships.description: samples layer properties at a frame
writes transforms as matrices and shapes as paths
reads scenes, layers, shapes and fills
